title: astragalus marschallianus
intro: Astragalus marschallianus, commonly known as Marshall's milkvetch, is a perennial legume plant native to the mountainous regions of China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus marschallianus include enhancing immune function, reducing fatigue, and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
